description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {B}.
Rograkh dies, triggering Blood Artist, causing target player to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.
